candidate.text: Added support for warmup configuration in DestinationRule's LB trafficPolicy duration: specify the duration of warmup mode minimumPercent : specifies the initial percent of origin load aggression : will define the evolution of the % of traffic sent to the pods from minimumPercent to 100%

evidence.excerpt:
- |
    **Added** support for warmup configuration in DestinationRule's LB trafficPolicy

    duration: specify the duration of warmup mode
    minimumPercent : specifies the initial percent of origin load
    aggression : will define the evolution of the % of traffic sent to the pods from minimumPercent to 100%
